subtitle: 고상한 직업들 사이 대놓고 수상한 도적의 본업

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
난 검과 방패의 모험가!
옆엔 빛의 성직자고!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle heroic tavern hall shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal wooden floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, proud Orc Warrior protection tank strikes a noble heroic pose lifting her 1H sword and sturdy steel kite shield with sparkling crimson eyes and a confident grin. On the right, serene Night Elf Priest (lavender half-up hair, gold crescent tiara, zero angel halo or wings, gold cross staff stowed on back) clasps her empty hands piously with a gentle golden sparkle around her waist mini Holy Book.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
난 정규 마법 학자야!
근데 도적, 넌 직업이 뭐야?
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic interview shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal wooden floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, smug Skyborne Mage (blue crystal staff stowed on back, tilted blue wizard hat with cloud-wing badge) lifts her chin proudly waving a rolled parchment academy diploma tied with a ribbon. On the right, fidgeting Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, green forehead goggles, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) glances sideways whistling nervously with a big sweat drop.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
어… 뭐 그냥 이것저것 해
별일 없는데? 왜 물어봐?
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle stealthy comedic shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal wooden floor touch and wide open pure #FFFFFF upper-right space (zero text or speech bubbles). On the left, shifty Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, green forehead goggles, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) waves one empty hand casually with an awkward grin while her other sneaky hand reaches behind toward a tied brown leather gold pouch at the belt of Orc Warrior standing in the lower-right (1H sword sheathed at hip, sturdy steel kite shield resting by her leg) who looks down suspiciously.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 82 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with sharp shock impact streaks and zero text or speech bubbles. Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, green forehead goggles, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) freezes dead in her tracks caught red-handed with huge panicked blue eyes, comically guilty stiff smile, and pouring sweat drops while clutching a bulging tied brown leather gold pouch spilling shiny round gold coins right under her chin.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
직업 이름이 대놓고 도적인데
굳이 숨길 필요가 있어요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind flustered Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, twin green daggers sheathed at waist, hiding the brown leather gold pouch awkwardly behind her back in lower-right foreground) looking at Night Elf Priest on the left, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background (zero text or speech bubbles). On the left, unimpressed Night Elf Priest (lavender half-up hair, gold crescent tiara, zero angel halo or wings, gold cross staff stowed on back) stares deadpan with half-lidded lavender-silver eyes pointing straight at the shiny round gold coins dripping out behind Rogue's back.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
직업에 충실한 거거든?!
칼소멸로 먼저 튄다, 수고!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view wide slapstick chase finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal wooden floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the right, cheeky Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) leaps backward laughing inside a crisp swirling white Vanish smoke puff clutching the tied brown leather gold pouch. On the left, furious Orc Warrior protection tank (1H sword at hip and sturdy steel kite shield strapped on back) lunges forward reaching out with frantic empty hands chasing her through the smoke.
